
GPS Map (Lite) 2.x notes
========================

This version is highly optimized for MP2x00.
Although not extensively tested, GPS Map 2.x should run
without problems also on MP130.
Because of the limited heap space on MP120 you should use
version 1.x instead on this model to avoid problems. 

Please read also the manual supplement included, called
"GM20Sup.pdf" before using this software!
